rendered: Knocking out dacA, which encodes the peptidoglycan synthase DacA, a negative regulator of prodigiosin, was reported by Pan et al. The deletion altered cell morphology and increased membrane permeability, which facilitated intracellular prodigiosin release and upregulated pigA. The result was a[1][2] 2.46-fold[3] yield increase over wild-type JNB5–1. The deletion is in strain SK4–72[4], which Table 2[5] lists as derived from JNB5–1 (JNB5–1 → SK4–72), giving 15,630[6] mg L-1 prodigiosin in shake flask culture over 108[7] hours.[8]
